title: Design System: Mountain Culture Guitar Lessons

display.purpose: Section headlines, 900 weight, slate on cream / white on the forest footer bookend.

display-light.purpose: Hero masthead connective words ("Turn", "Into A"), thin 300 weight against the heavy emphasis word.

brush.purpose: One hand-marked hero word only, set on a terracotta swatch.

shadows.name: card-featured
shadows.purpose: The one featured card per section, paired with a thick terracotta border.

shadows.name: hero-ambient-forest
shadows.purpose: Hero-only ambient backlight (primary accent), confirmed exception to the No-Glow default.

motion.name: status-ping
motion.purpose: Marks a real, currently-true status (accepting students now) -- never a fabricated live feed. Hero only.

motion.name: sparkle-twinkle
motion.purpose: Decorative hero flourish, SVG not emoji.

components.name: Primary Button (Forest)
components.description: Solid forest-green pill button, white text -- the system's primary-action color, used everywhere except the forest footer bookend (where it switches to terracotta for contrast).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2C4A3E; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 13px; padding: 16px 36px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1E342B; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Card (White)
components.description: The system's single card surface -- white on cream, used identically across features, pricing, reviews, and locations.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E0D9C9; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; color: #1E2C25; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

components.name: Trust Banner Pill
components.description: Confirmed-fact-only trust pill, white on cream.
components.css: .ds-trust-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E0D9C9; color: #1E2C25; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview: The page runs on a single warm cream canvas with white card surfaces for contrast, instead of the prior dark/light alternation. Forest green is the primary-action color -- every button, every checkmark -- while terracotta is the secondary, decorative accent -- stars, badges, ribbons, the hero's hand-brushed word. The Footer CTA band and Footer are the one deliberate dark, brand-color anchor on the page. Trust is still built through specificity -- a real map, real stats, real testimonials -- not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Single cream canvas for every content section; white cards carry contrast where needed
Two-accent system: forest (primary action/confirmation) vs. terracotta (decorative/informational), never interchangeable
Footer CTA band and Footer are solid forest green -- the page's one dark bookend
Live-status pulse uses emerald-500, independent of the two brand accents
Typography (Montserrat/Inter/Caveat) carried over unchanged from prior identities

rules.name: The Two-Accent Split Rule
rules.body: Forest = primary action and confirmation (buttons, checkmarks). Terracotta = decorative and informational (stars, badges, ribbons). Never interchangeable on the same element.

rules.name: The One Dark Anchor Rule
rules.body: Only the Footer CTA band and Footer depart from the cream canvas, in solid forest green -- a bounded bookend, not a return to dark/light alternation.

rules.name: The Hero-Only Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow and sparkle accents are a deliberate, confirmed hero flourish, not a system-wide depth cue.

rules.name: The Honest-Pulse Rule
rules.body: The hero's status-badge pulse marks a real, currently-true state, never a fabricated live-updating feed.

dos: Do keep forest strictly for primary actions and confirmation signals.
Do keep terracotta strictly for decorative/informational accents.
Do keep the cream canvas consistent across every section except the forest footer bookend.
Do state only confirmed facts in the trust banner.
Do keep the map embed scoped to the area with a real studio.
donts: Don't let forest and terracotta compete as interchangeable accents on the same element.
Don't add a third accent hue.
Don't stack two bordered/backgrounded containers inside each other for ordinary content.
Don't animate a status indicator to suggest a live feed when the fact is just true/false.
